# Dr. Abdullah Karamat

> Prosthodontist and certified implantologist practising in Lahore, Pakistan.
> Assistant Professor of Prosthodontics at Azra Naheed Dental College.
> Sees patients at Smile Hub Clinics, Johar Town, Lahore.

## Identity
- Full name: Dr. Abdullah Karamat
- Specialty: Prosthodontics (fixed and removable), dental implantology
- Qualifications: BDS (University of Health Sciences, Lahore, 2013); C-Implant (Institute of Advanced Dental Sciences, Lahore, 2015); FCPS Prosthodontics (College of Physicians and Surgeons Pakistan, 2022); CHPE (Superior University, Lahore, 2024)
- Academic appointment: Assistant Professor of Prosthodontics, Azra Naheed Dental College, Lahore, since 2021
- Clinical practice: Smile Hub Clinics, 599 Main Boulevard, Q Block, Phase 2, Johar Town, Lahore 54000, Pakistan
- Canonical entity URI: https://drabdullahkaramat.com/#person
